messages:
nina: Quick heads-up: planning a small runtime image pin for EU Dedicated to v2.3-quant tonight. Need ops + SRE sign-off.

nina: RN draft:
- change: pin eu-dedicated runtime image to v2.3-quant
- purpose: reduced memory & ~15% cost improvement for long sequences
- canary: gradual traffic steps 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 30m (total ~90m)
- rollback: envoy 5xx >0.6% sustained for 5m OR token_latency.p95 >25% above baseline for 5m
- customer impact: no API/schema changes

deploy-bot: /deploy rollout runtime:v2.3-quant target=eu-dedicated start=2026-03-30T23:45Z queued. preview: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/1746005555

sre-oncall: Agree with signals above. Also add watch for logs tagged "kernel-mismatch". Use envoy 5xx as primary immediate signal.

sam: Ops note: freeze autoscaler before first step to avoid scale-downs during canary. Command to run:
kubectl -n infra patch hpa runtime-service -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":3}}' --type=merge

support: We'll prepare a 2-line internal support blurb noting possible brief latency spikes during step ups. Send to #support 15m after first step.

legal-bot: Legal quick-check: runtime binary distribution unchanged; no compliance blockers (auto-ack).

nina: Rollback snippet for ops:
/ops traffic-split set eu-dedicated runtime:v2.3-quant=0 runtime:v2.2=100
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/runtime-service runtime=image:redwood/runtime:v2.2

sre-oncall: I'll run the dashboard watchlist and post status updates every 10m during the canary. If rollback criteria hit, I'll open bridge and tag @eng-oncall.

nina: Final RN uploaded: https://docs.redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-eu-dedicated-v2.3-quant. Will post internal announce ~15m after deploy-bot reports first step applied.
